privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Earlsfield Electricians
privacy.description: How Earlsfield Electricians handles personal information submitted through this website.
privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy explains how we handle personal information submitted through this website.
privacy.informationCollected: If you submit an enquiry, we collect your name, phone number, selected service and any details you include in your message.
privacy.purpose: We use this information to respond to your enquiry, discuss requested work and keep a record of our communications.
privacy.lawfulBasis: We process enquiry details to take steps you request before entering into a contract. Where we retain enquiry records or handle related follow-up, confirm and document the appropriate lawful basis before publication.
privacy.sharing: This demonstration quote form is not connected to an inbox or form provider. Do not submit personal information until a service has been configured and this policy updated.
privacy.internationalTransfers: Before publication, confirm whether the form provider or other recipients transfer information outside the UK and describe the applicable safeguards, if relevant.
privacy.retention: Set the enquiry retention period and deletion process before publication; do not keep personal information for longer than necessary.
privacy.security: We take appropriate steps to protect enquiry information. Confirm the practical safeguards used by the business and its service providers before publication.
privacy.rights: Depending on the circumstances, you may have rights to access, correct or erase your personal information, restrict or object to processing, and request data portability. You may also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office.
privacy.cookies: This template does not intentionally set analytics cookies. Review embedded maps, images and other third-party services and update this section to describe any data or cookies they use.
privacy.complaints: You can raise a concern with the UK Information Commissioner's Office. We encourage you to contact us first so we can try to resolve it.
